claims.text: Hurley stage I: intralesional triamcinolone, 0.1 to 0.5 mL of 5 to 10 mg/mL once a month
claims.quote: For Hurley stage I disease, typical treatment includes topical 1% clindamycin solution 2 times a day, topical resorcinol 15% cream once a day, oral zinc gluconate (90 mg once a day), intralesional glucocorticoids (eg, 0.1 to 0.5 mL of a 5- to 10-mg/mL solution of triamcinolone acetonide once a month)
